overview:
CA-42 leans Democratic by about 8 points, and first-term incumbent Robert Garcia is seeking re-election with a commanding financial advantage. He has raised $3.3 million and holds $1.6 million on hand, while Republican Brian Burley has raised roughly $250,000 with only about $5,000 remaining. Outside groups have spent modestly in support of Garcia and nothing against him.

No public general-election polls or expert ratings cover this race, so the outlook rests on district fundamentals and candidate resources. Prediction markets price Garcia's win probability near 96 percent, consistent with the district's lean and the lopsided money race. With incumbency, fundraising, and partisan lean all aligned, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with an expected margin of roughly 20 points.
